bandReport.notes: Band covers booklet pages 21-A, 23-A, 25-A, 27-A (PDF indices 10-13), Q66-Q90 contiguous with no gaps. Q66 opens p10 left column as a complete question (stem + four options), so nothing continues in from p09. Q90 closes p13 right column complete (stem + four options ending above the footer rule), so nothing spills to p14. No question straddles a page break and no option block straddles the column break anywhere in the band. Three Match Lists (Q71, Q73, Q85), each a 4x4 A-D vs 1-4 grid with a Code table of four rows; NONE of them prints an all-options row and no code row was found at any position other than (a)-(d) as transcribed. Every code table was re-cropped at 6x and read column by column against the A B C D header. Neighbouring-band sightings: none - p10 begins with Q66 at the top of the left column and p13 ends with Q90 at the foot of the right column, so I can see nothing belonging to B2 or B4.
